description: Currency converter for invoices, quotes and budgets: convert an amount from one currency into up to 10 others using European Central Bank rates (latest or a past date). Returns rounded amounts, rate, inverse rate and the 7 day change in percent for each target. Price $0.002 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"source":"European Central Bank via Frankfurter","amount":1250,"from":"USD","rate_date":"2026-10-27","conversions":[{"currency":"EUR","rate":0.89686,"inverse_rate":1.115,"converted":1121.08,"change_7d_pct":0.925}],"change_7d_reference_date":"2026-10-20"}

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD for a historical rate

to.description: Comma list of up to 10 target currency codes

name: fx_convert
